```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)


df <- read_csv("taxa_long_tues_enhanced.csv")


```

```{r}




ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = log10(zooplankton + eps),
           y = log10(reads + eps),
           colour = Group_precise)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Zooplankton group relative abundance + eps)",
    y = "log10(Reads group relative abundance + eps)",
    colour = "Group"
  )
```
